decisions.reason: As the flagship closely aligned with existing agricultural crates and design capabilities, the firm's absorptive capacity remains high, so it can learn from feedback and keep improving it.
Because foldable large containers build directly on established container expertise and dedicated promotion, the firm can assimilate market feedback and improve the line.

Although spill-retention pallets require additional environmental/safety knowledge, the firm's pallet expertise and research cooperation give it enough absorptive capacity to keep improving the product.
With load retainers close to existing pallet offerings, the firm has high related knowledge and can apply lessons from its core pallet business to keep this product.
